title: Bias-Only Training Dynamics in ReLU Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.24797v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural networks with randomly initialized, fixed weights and trainable biases are universal approximators, yet the dynamics of bias-only training remain largely unexplored. We study these dynamics in one-hidden-layer ReLU networks through activation codes, the binary patterns of active neurons that partition the input space into convex polyhedral regions. We show that the gradients with respect to the biases depend on each input only through its activation code, and hence the training dynamics can be characterized with these codes. In particular, as long as the activation codes remain fixed, training reduces to a linear least-squares problem with the codes as features. Training can then be understood as a sequence of least-squares problems, with transitions occurring when neurons change their activation states. translated_title: ReLU网络中的仅偏置训练动力学
translated_abstract: 具有随机初始化固定权重、仅训练偏置的神经网络是通用逼近器，但仅偏置训练的动力学在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们通过“激活码”来研究单隐层ReLU网络中的这些动力学——激活码是活跃神经元的二进制模式，它将输入空间划分为凸多面体区域。我们证明，关于偏置的梯度仅通过每个输入的激活码依赖于该输入，因此训练动力学可以用这些激活码来刻画。特别地，只要激活码保持不变，训练就退化为以激活码为特征的线性最小二乘问题。训练因此可以理解为一系列最小二乘问题，当神经元改变其激活状态时发生状态转换。我们证明，随着网络宽度增大，发生切换的神经元比例趋于消失，训练动力学趋近于线性（网络）的动力学……
tldr: 该论文提出用“激活码”刻画单隐层ReLU网络仅训练偏置时的训练动力学，证明训练等价于一系列以激活码为特征的线性最小二乘问题，且网络变宽时神经元切换比例趋近于零、动力学趋于线性。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes bias-only training dynamics in one-hidden-layer ReLU networks via activation codes, showing that training reduces to a sequence of least-squares problems and approaches linear dynamics as the network width grows.
